thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: SEV-2 — cuda_alloc_failure spikes on gpu-pool-west2 (3x retries). Auto-suppress threshold hit.
maya: Acked (oncall). Looking now. :eyes:
sam: Seeing the same in metrics — sudden mem alloc failures, KV cache evictions spiking.
liam: Any customer-facing errors? paging the SLA owner.
rachel: Ops dashboard shows a tail of 502s from the inference gateway for west2. Not wide but two tenants affected.
maya: Details: routed 95% of traffic to pool-west2 for a low-latency customer batch, that pool hit frag/alloc. Rolling fallback not fully engaged.
sam: Quick mitigation — reduce concurrency on that pool and reroute new requests. Can someone run the drain command?
liam: Running:
```
# cordon pool-west2, soft-drain
redwoodctl pool update pool-west2 --max-concurrency 8 --drain-mode soft
```
maya: Done. Also increasing fallback capacity:
```
redwoodctl pool scale cpu-infer-west2 --add 4
```
rachel: Applied reroute rule to send non-SLA traffic to cpu-infer-west2. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: alert acknowledged by maya. Escalation to eng-ml if failures persist.
sam: Logs from affected pods (trimmed):
```
[2026-03-16T02:13:01Z] cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (requested=1.2GB) /dev/nvidia0
[2026-03-16T02:13:02Z] kv_cache_evict: freed 512MB (fragmentation high)
[2026-03-16T02:13:04Z] cudaLaunchKernel: retrying, alloc fail
```
maya: Likely fragmentation from a sudden long-seq burst + concurrent prefetch. We're seeing many small allocs fail even though free memory > threshold.
sam: Suggest enabling aggressive KV compaction for the pool and temporarily disable prefetch for that model.
liam: Patch rolling now to set `MODEL_PREFETCH=false` for the model flavor on pool-west2.
rachel: Customer impact: Tenant A saw 20% request failures for 2.5 minutes; Tenant B had latency tail up +15% for ~3 minutes. No broader region impact.
maya: Communicated to support: short blip, mitigations applied, we're monitoring.
sam: Monitoring: error rate dropping to baseline after drain/reroute; KV evictions stabilizing.
liam: Will follow up with an infra postmortem on fragmentation causes and autoscaler behavior. Leaving PagerDuty on-call open for 30m.
rachel: Adding notebook traces and core dumps to the incident artifact bucket: gs://redwood-incidents/1780056789/
maya: Thanks all. Action items: (1) eng-ml investigate prefetch pattern + model memory footprints, (2) eng-sre consider fallback tuning to avoid single-pool saturation, (3) product notify affected customers with RCA when ready.
sam: +1 — I'll own (1). Setting a short eval to reproduce with long-seq load.
liam: I'll collect kernel traces and fragmentation histograms.
rachel: I'll draft the customer note draft and share in #support.
maya: Closing thread after monitoring window. If anything flares back up, re-open and re-escalate. :thumbsup:
